mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_feedback (conversation_id, user_id, message_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{messageId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COUNT(*) AS down_count FROM ai_feedback WHERE rating = 'DOWN' AND created_at >= now() - (#{limit} || ' days')::interval GROUP BY to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY day DESC
